decisions.decision: restored the end.After(today) 400 rule the worker's design.md D9 had dropped, at UTC today rather than history's browser-yesterday
decisions.why: AGENTS.md states the 400 rules as a closed set and the roadmap said 'same 400 rules'; D10 derives chart buckets from the window, so a far-future end inside the 400-day cap would render empty future bars.

decisions.decision: kept the worker's UTC 'today' frame (no browser_tz cookie, no browserToday) for this endpoint
decisions.why: Avoids adding timezone coupling the roadmap never asked for; matches the old clampSuperchargerMonths path. Cost: this endpoint's future-date boundary sits one day from history's.

decisions.decision: applied the D9 revision as leader edits instead of re-dispatching the worker
decisions.why: The worker died on a session limit before editing; a cold worker would re-read the full doc pack (~300k tokens) to make four targeted artifact edits.

decisions.decision: accepted the worker's D5 (month-aligned default/presets), D10 (window-derived bucket count) and its skipping of a separate grill-me session
decisions.why: D5/D10 preserve exact prior chart-bucket behaviour; the roadmap's owner-approved Decisions satisfy the grill-me proposal rule, as in tier 1.

decisions.decision: refactored the worker's duplicated Page/Fragment branch logic into the superchargerStatsViewFor helper tasks.md 2.1 specified, and switched the Page 400 path from render to renderError
decisions.why: Worker inlined ~30 identical lines in both handlers; tasks.md required the helper. renderError sets errorFragmentHeader, which render omits, so htmx would have dropped the 400 body.

decisions.decision: deferred the Step 5.7 suite ask to the end of wave 3 rather than asking now
decisions.why: supercharger_test.go still targets the old API, so go test ./internal/gateway/... cannot compile until task 3.1 rewrites it. Asking now would return a guaranteed compile failure.
